description: This file defines the CookieJar class that manages HTTP cookies, including their storage, retrieval, filtering, and cookie header creation, as part of the GuzzleHttp HTTP client library.

classes.name: CookieJar
classes.description: A class that implements a cookie jar which stores cookies as an array and provides methods for cookie management, including adding, retrieving, filtering, and exporting cookies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a CookieJar instance, optionally in strict mode, and initializes it with an array of SetCookie objects or raw cookie data.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a new CookieJar instance from an associative array of cookies and a specific domain.

methods.name: shouldPersist
methods.description: Determines whether a given cookie should be persisted based on its expiration, discard flag, and session allowance.

methods.name: getCookieByName
methods.description: Searches for and returns a cookie matching the specified name.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Exports all stored cookies as an array.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes cookies matching specified domain, path, and name criteria.

methods.name: clearSessionCookies
methods.description: Removes all session cookies that are not set to discard.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds or updates a cookie in the jar, validating and resolving conflicts as necessary.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of cookies stored.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the stored cookies.

methods.name: extractCookies
methods.description: Extracts cookies from HTTP response headers and adds them to the jar based on domain and path matching.

methods.name: getCookiePathFromRequest
methods.description: Computes the cookie path based on the request URI following RFC 6265.

methods.name: withCookieHeader
methods.description: Generates and adds a Cookie header to an HTTP request based on the stored cookies that match the request's URL.

methods.name: removeCookieIfEmpty
methods.description: Removes a cookie if its value is null or empty.
